summary: Standard Premium Finance Holdings, Inc. filed an 8-K reporting a stock repurchase of 76,000 shares at $2.25 per share under a board-authorized buyback program. The total repurchase value is approximately $171,000. The program was announced via a press release citing the company's strong 2025 financial performance, including a 24% net income increase and 27.5% EPS growth. The board authorized the program; no advisor is named. Structurally, this is an open-market repurchase returning capital to shareholders. The company continues to operate its premium finance business and seeks M&A opportunities. What to watch: future buyback tranches and potential synergistic acquisitions.
